title: German Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful twist on traditional German cuisine, this lamb tagine is a perfect blend of rich spices and tender meat.

ingredients.name: lamb
ingredients.notes: boneless lamb shoulder or neck, cut into 2-inch pieces

instructions: Heat the rich in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the xtra, moroccan, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and crushed tomatoes to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven. Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let cool slightly.
Serve the lamb hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
